title: Young man is fighting for life after he was bashed with a baseball bat during wild brawl in broad daylight
text:
By Max Aldred for Daily Mail Australia
Published: 15:08 GMT, February 9, 2025 | Updated: 15:18 GMT, February 9, 2025
A man has been interrogated by the police after another was seriously injured when he allegedly attacked with a baseball bat during a street fight in a suburban street.
The emergency services were called to a reserve in Byrnes ST in South Granville around 5.40 pm Sunday after reports of a melee combat that involved multiple males.
A 20 -year -old man was found on the scene with serious injuries and was urgently taken to the Westmead hospital with a police escort in a critical condition.
CCTV of a house of nearby homemade time 35 minutes before showed dozens of men in the reserve before a man suddenly flees down the street.
A group of at least seven men pursues it along the path and in the middle of the road.
CCTV shows a man fleeing the scene after a fight in a nearby reserve
At least seven men chase man, including one that appears to handle a baseball bat
One of the men pursued seems to exercise a baseball bat.
Another race through the center of the road is almost hit by a passing car.
Men finally surrender and run to the reserve a few moments later.
The group dispersed when the police arrived on the scene.
A man is fighting for life after he was supposedly attacked in the fight in the south of Granville
A man of about 20 years was arrested nearby and taken to the Auburn police station, where the night spent the police.
No charges have been presented as of Monday morning, a police spokesman Mail Australia said.
“Incident investigations continue and urges any witness or any person with information to present and communicate with the local police or the detainees of the crime,” said the spokesman.
